name: style-graphite
title: Graphite
description: A high-contrast neutral Neumorphism UI style with deep shadows and quick motion.

light.neu-shadow-raised-sm: 4px 4px 9px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), -4px -4px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.70) 45%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-inset: inset 3px 3px 9px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), inset -3px -3px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 65%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-primary: 4px 5px 10px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), -4px -4px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 86%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-hover: 5px 5px 12px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), -5px -5px 12px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.94) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 86%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #3f536f 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #c8545f 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #c8545f 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-floating: 0 16px 40px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), 0 3px 8px rgb(31 39 50 / 0.17), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.70) 45%, transparent)

dark.neu-shadow-raised-sm: 4px 4px 9px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), -4px -4px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08) 45%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-inset: inset 3px 3px 9px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), inset -3px -3px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 65%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-primary: 4px 5px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), -4px -4px 9px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 86%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-hover: 5px 5px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), -5px -5px 12px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045) 62%, transparent), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 86%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b2c2d8 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7885 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7885 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-floating: 0 16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), 0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48), inset 1px 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08) 45%, transparent)
